Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.ali

Class AliSmqQueue

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.driver.AbstractTopic<T>
com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.ali.AliBaseTopic<AliSmqQueue>
com.salesforce.multicloudj.pubsub.ali.AliSmqQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Provider, SdkService, AutoCloseable
@AutoService(AbstractTopic.class) public class AliSmqQueue extends AliBaseTopic<AliSmqQueue>
Alibaba SMQ (MNS) queue publisher.

Publishes messages to an SMQ queue via batchPutMessage. Registered under the alismqqueue provider id.

    • doSendBatch

      protected void doSendBatch(List<Message> messages)
      Publishes a batch of messages to the SMQ queue via batchPutMessage.

      A logical batch whose cumulative encoded size would exceed the SMQ per-request limit is first split into service-valid sub-batches (see splitBySize), each sent with its own batchPutMessage call; a single message that alone exceeds the limit fails fast before any call is made.

      The entire batch is converted to SMQ SDK messages up front, before any batchPutMessage call, so a purely local conversion failure (for example metadata that exceeds the SMQ per-message limits, see toSmqMessage) fails fast without leaving an earlier sub-batch already published.

      SMQ's batchPutMessage may accept some messages in a batch while rejecting others. On any per-message failure this surfaces the first rejected entry and fails the entire batch, so every message future in the batch completes exceptionally, including messages SMQ already accepted. Under at-least-once delivery, a caller that retries the batch may therefore re-publish the already-accepted messages, so consumers must tolerate duplicate delivery.

      Specified by:
      doSendBatch in class AbstractTopic<AliSmqQueue>
